question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing left winger, Bob is playing fullback, Claire is playing left back, Dave is playing left midfielder, Eve is playing goalkeeper, Fred is playing right back, and Gertrude is playing sweeper.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Fred and Gertrude trade positions. Then, Fred and Alice trade positions. Then, Alice and Eve trade positions. Then, Claire and Eve trade positions. Then, Fred and Bob trade positions. Then, Eve and Claire trade positions. Finally, Bob and Dave trade positions. At the end of the match, Fred is playing
Options:
(A) left winger
(B) fullback
(C) left back
(D) left midfielder
(E) goalkeeper
(F) right back
(G) sweeper
solution:
Player order in every row: Alice | Bob | Claire | Dave | Eve | Fred | Gertrude.
Initial: left winger | fullback | left back | left midfielder | goalkeeper | right back | sweeper
1. Fred ↔ Gertrude: left winger | fullback | left back | left midfielder | goalkeeper | sweeper | right back
2. Fred ↔ Alice: sweeper | fullback | left back | left midfielder | goalkeeper | left winger | right back
3. Alice ↔ Eve: goalkeeper | fullback | left back | left midfielder | sweeper | left winger | right back
4. Claire ↔ Eve: goalkeeper | fullback | sweeper | left midfielder | left back | left winger | right back
5. Fred ↔ Bob: goalkeeper | left winger | sweeper | left midfielder | left back | fullback | right back
6. Eve ↔ Claire: goalkeeper | left winger | left back | left midfielder | sweeper | fullback | right back
7. Bob ↔ Dave: goalkeeper | left midfielder | left back | left winger | sweeper | fullback | right back
Fred's final position is fullback, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
